name: mstack-evidence
description: Turns customer feedback (support tickets, interview notes, survey answers) into evidence for product people: the problems people have, each with a count whose items are listed, exact quotes with their place, and a strength by a written rule. It records what people asked for without recommending a solution, says what the sample cannot show, replaces customers' personal data with roles, and checks every quote and count against the sources with a script before showing anything. Nothing is sent to another vendor's model. mstack-product-plan, mstack-epic and mstack-write-specs take the approved document as a source. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Turn customer feedback into problems with counts and exact quotes.
interface.longDescription: Reads support tickets, interview notes or survey answers and writes an evidence document: each problem with the number of items that mention it, the items listed, up to three exact quotes with their place, and how strong the evidence is. A script checks every quote and count against the sources. It describes problems and recommends no solution, keeps contradicting voices, names the limits of the sample, and replaces customers' names with roles.
